attacks.name: 1. F1 KILL: mutate anchored event + full re-chain + .meta rewrite → ANCHOR_MISMATCH/root-mismatch; --tx never prints INCLUSION VERIFIED
2. F2 KILL: delete the ENTIRE audit tree; external anchor supplied → ANCHOR_MISMATCH/deletion, exit 1
3. tail truncation below latest treeSize + .meta rewrite → ANCHOR_MISMATCH/rollback
4. rollback to an older internally-valid snapshot → ANCHOR_MISMATCH/rollback (AC-1.3)
5. fork: rewrite events ≤ treeSize, regrow chain → root-mismatch + consistency-failure (AC-1.4, row 17)
6. attacker keypair re-signs full history; auditor pins the real root → ANCHOR_INVALID (AC-6.3)
7. key swap inside the vault: doctored identity.json + attacker-signed mirror → ANCHOR_INVALID (pinned root governs)
8. gap: middle record deleted from the supplied set (mirror wiped) → anchor-chain-gap (AC-1.5)
9. monotonicity: decreasing treeSize across records → ANCHOR_MISMATCH
10. fork evidence: same prevAnchorHash, same key, DIVERGENT content → ANCHOR_MISMATCH/fork
11. benign duplicate: identical modulo timestamp/sig → ANCHORED_VERIFIED + duplicate-anchor warning
12. emitter race with the lock: exactly one record minted, loser skips
13. mirror↔external disagreement at one anchorSeq → ANCHOR_MISMATCH/mirror-disagreement; external governs (AC-1.2)
14. cross-vault replay: valid record from another vaultId → ANCHOR_MISMATCH/vault-id-mismatch
15. corrupt JSON and unknown extra fields → ANCHOR_INVALID (fail-closed)
16. degenerate numerics (treeSize 0 / negative / float / unsafe) → ANCHOR_INVALID/range-invalid, NO throw
18. stale beyond thresholds → ANCHOR_STALE; exit 0 default, 1 strict
19. future-dated timestamp on the newest anchor → future-timestamp warning; event threshold still fires
20. anchors present, no trust material → ANCHOR_UNVERIFIABLE/no-trust-material; exit 0 default, 1 strict
21. legacy vault, no anchors anywhere → UNANCHORED; exit 0 default, 1 strict (AC-4.1)
22. witness unreachable → ANCHOR_UNVERIFIABLE/witness-unreachable; NEVER ANCHORED_VERIFIED from the mirror (AC-2.4)
23. witness disagrees: fetched record contradicts the vault → ANCHOR_MISMATCH, always exit 1
24. records after a rotation still signed by the superseded key → ANCHOR_MISMATCH/rotation-continuity
25. genesis under a successor pin instead of the root → ANCHOR_MISMATCH (valid sig, wrong position)
26. rotation hijack with pins supplied: rotation to an unpinned key → ANCHOR_MISMATCH/rotation-unpinned
27. rotation without pins: accepted + prominent rotation-unpinned warning; successor chain verifies
28. competing rotations extending the same predecessor → ANCHOR_MISMATCH/fork
29. mirror-only + --require-external-anchor → exit 1 (state stays ANCHORED_VERIFIED)
30. happy paths: single anchor / full history / grown chain / post-rotation keyring → ANCHORED_VERIFIED
